summary: Discussion-sourced field reports: Anthropic/Claude Code secret exposures, Docker sandbox escape report, Vercel Labs agent-browser, Mapricot MCP server chatter, DeepSeek policy ban, plus operator workflows on agent memory, Copilot desktop cookies, and mobile AHP tooling. | Vendor-only shard: multiple vendor releases and case studies signal progress on agent orchestration, routing, MCP runtimes, governance, and sandbox scaling. Missing social/operator discussion coverage for field reports. | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple vendor releases for agent runtimes and browser automation plus new MCP/server releases; many single-repo agent platforms need social/operator corroboration. | Package-snapshot: MCP servers, agent runtimes, memory libs, VS Code agent UX and security tooling show active ecosystem growth; OpenAI releases and high-download MCP SDKs are highest-priority.
